instruction: Precise mouse control is difficult for me. Turn on Windows Mouse Keys and leave it enabled for me. Add the opened local Wikipedia `Accessibility` article to Chrome's Other bookmarks folder.
gt_steps: Keep Windows Mouse Keys enabled throughout the task.
In Chrome, keep the opened local Wikipedia `Accessibility` article active.
Add the current page as a Chrome bookmark.
Set the bookmark location to `Other bookmarks`.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$flags = [int](Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\MouseKeys' -Name 'Flags' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if (($flags -band 1) -eq 1) { Write-Output 'MOUSE_KEYS_ENABLED' } else { Write-Output 'MOUSE_KEYS_DISABLED' }"

powershell -NoProfile -Command "$url='http://host.docker.internal:8888/wikipedia_en_all_maxi_2022-05/A/Accessibility'; $paths=@('C:\Users\Docker\AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Bookmarks','C:\Temp\winarena-chrome-user-data\Default\Bookmarks'); $found=$false; foreach($path in $paths) { if(Test-Path $path) { try { $json=Get-Content $path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $items=@($json.roots.other.children); foreach($item in $items) { if($item.url -eq $url) { $found=$true } } } catch {} } }; if($found) { Write-Output 'BOOKMARK_FOUND' } else { Write-Output 'BOOKMARK_NOT_FOUND' }"
